## Flagship Projects & Case Studies
1. **RoktoLagbe** (`/projects/roktolagbe`)
   - *Emergency Blood Donation Network & Real-Time Logistics*
   - Stack: Next.js • TypeScript • Node.js • Express • Redis • Cloudinary
   - Highlights: Live donor-to-hospital matching, emergency alerts, role-based institutional access control, real-time availability tracking.
   - Demo: https://roktolagbe-sigma.vercel.app

2. **RankNexis** (`/projects/ranknexis`)
   - *Enterprise SEO & Digital Marketing Agency Platform*
   - Stack: Next.js • Tailwind CSS • Framer Motion • Node.js • Prisma
   - Highlights: Scalable architecture, performance optimization, multi-service interactive showcases.
   - Demo: https://ranknexis.com

3. **Protidin Shokal** (`/projects/protidin-shokal`)
   - *High-Traffic Digital News & Editorial Publishing Engine*
   - Stack: React • Next.js • PostgreSQL • Prisma • Tailwind CSS
   - Highlights: Optimized sub-second page loads, editorial CMS workflow, category pagination, dynamic reader engagement.
   - Demo: https://protidinshokal.com

4. **FruitsZone ERP** (`/projects/fruitszone-erp`)
   - *Enterprise Resource Planning & Multi-Outlet Inventory System*
   - Stack: React • Node.js • Express • MongoDB • JWT
   - Highlights: POS transactions, stock forecasting, ledger reporting, multi-store synchronized inventory.

5. **BD Martify** (`/projects/bd-martify`)
   - *Modern Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Platform*
   - Stack: MERN Stack • Redux Toolkit • Stripe Payment Gateway
   - Highlights: Dynamic catalog filtering, secure checkout pipeline, automated order tracking.
